title.narrative: Urgent Support for war affected people through providing them by food assistance and implementing small gardens initiatives

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe project titled " Urgent Support for war affected people through providing them with food assistance and implementing small gardens initiatives. The food assistance support will include fresh and dry food parcels, while the implementation of home gardening initiatives will include agricultural inputs such as supplying seeds, seedlings, irrigation networks, water storage tanks, and organic fertilizers. The food assistance activity aim to support displaced and affected people during the current war on the Gaza Strip in accessing to fresh food and dry food , where each HHs will receive 4 rounds of food parcels, 2 rounds as fresh food parcels such as different types of vegetables , eggs , fresh chicken and fruits the other 2 rounds will be as dry food parcels distributed such as rice, oil, wheat, macaroni, and different types of canned food( meat, fish, peas,…extra) , the periods between the rounds will be at least 10 days . The activity of establishing home gardens comes within the framework of enhancing home production of vegetables, securing families’ food needs, and mitigating the impact of the rise in agricultural product prices due to the shrinkage of agricultural land areas and the destruction of more than 85% of it by Israeli Army. The project is designed to comply with the FSS Cluster Objective: Enhancing food security by providing targeted, balanced, and fresh food assistance, improving food production, and boosting household income. Focusing on addressing food insecurity and mitigating famine risks through coordinated support and sustainable agricultural practices and complying with the flash appeal priorities " Provide emergencies, dignified, and diversified food assistance through in-kind, vouchers, cash, and hybrid modalities, and provide essential inputs such as seeds, irrigation systems to promote urban agriculture initiatives, including community gardening. Through the implementation of the project, 2040 HHs will be targeted, 2000 HHs as food parcels beneficiaries and 40 HHs as Home gardens beneficiaries. Total targeted people will be 11480 individuals, 5649 female, 5831 male, 2915 women, 2698 girls, 3042 men and 2825 boys. The targeted locations will be Gaza North Gaza and middle area governoratesltbrgtThe planned project activities can be summarized as follows:ltbrgt1. Distribution of 6000 Food parcels for 2000 HHsltbrgt2. Establishment of 50 Home Garden to 50 HHSltbrgtlt/pgt
